rows.text:
Re-review: both original probes now pass (nested mutation rejects with 2540/2339; adding the missing component emits recovery event 2).
- Introduced typing regression: type.read(input) returns readonly arrays, but attach/update require mutable P; a validated {values:number[]} payload fails TS2345 on attachment.
- Accept immutable payload inputs without weakening capability inference, and add a valid compiled array/recursive roundtrip.
- Tighten the recovery regression to add a missing component on an existing node; creating a node invalidates all views and masks the original defect.
